h: Peller reportedly accuses Jarvis's family of disrespect, and Jarvis hits back
p: Streamer Peller has reportedly said a member of Jarvis's family refused to greet him even in his own home. Jarvis is said to have answered by rejecting pressure to show him respect, in a reply that has split fans online. The pair's on-and-off relationship has drawn heavy attention for months.
more: The exchange has been shared widely on TikTok and Instagram.
Fans are divided, with some backing Peller and others siding with Jarvis.
Neither has said whether they plan to settle the matter privately.
